get_scene_frame_names: get scene frame names from a config dict with optional root directory and keyframe filtering
get_scene_names: get a filtered and optionally shuffled list of scene names from a root directory using config
filter_scenes: filter a list of scene names by regex, index range, modality existence, or processing state
filter_frame_names: filter frame names by index range, modality file existence, or regex pattern matching
get_video_frames: extract video frame names from a scene metadata dict using chunk start, end, and fps values
